##### Project general facts

Rimal Residences is a contemporary G+5 residential development comprising 203 units, ranging from studios to spacious two-bedroom apartments. Located adjacent to the Maryam Gate Residences community, the project benefits from a well-connected setting within Maryam Island, offering easy access to landscaped parks, retail outlets, and the beachfront promenade. Its architecture reflects a modern low-rise design approach, combining clean lines, balanced proportions, and a refined coastal aesthetic.

The development offers a selection of lifestyle-focused amenities designed for comfort and relaxation. Residents enjoy access to a private swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, and a landscaped podium with dedicated green spaces exclusively for residents. The surrounding masterplan further enhances the experience with nearby parks, walking paths, retail destinations, and leisure areas, creating a well-integrated and convenient waterfront community.

The interiors are designed with a light and modern aesthetic, using porcelain tiles throughout living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and balconies, complemented by matching skirting for a cohesive finish. The kitchens feature modern open layouts with MDF cabinetry and laminate finishes. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to personalize their homes according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits 

Rimal Residences is located within the prestigious Maryam Island masterplan in Sharjah, a prime waterfront destination overlooking Al Khan Lagoon. The development enjoys a highly strategic position near Maryam Gate Residences and Maryam Beach Residence, offering residents seamless access to the island’s vibrant promenade, sandy beach, and landscaped public spaces.

The location is well connected to key city routes, including Corniche Road, ensuring easy access to central Sharjah and neighbouring emirates. Residents benefit from a walkable community setting with nearby retail outlets, cafés, restaurants, and leisure attractions, all integrated within a lively waterfront environment.

Maryam Island itself is designed as a modern coastal lifestyle destination, combining urban convenience with resort-style living. With its marina, green parks, waterfront walkways, and panoramic lagoon views, the area offers a relaxed yet connected lifestyle ideal for both families and professionals.
